name: getownly
description: getownly - online course marketplace with Thai PromptPay wallet top-up

scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:migrate:name: pnpm --filter backend db:migrate:name
scripts.test: pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @getownly/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter backend typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
